name: @canmyagentuse/web
description: Public Can My Agent Use catalog on Astro 7 and Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.catalog:validate: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/validate-catalog.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/validate-research.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/validate-representations.ts
scripts.dev: pnpm run marks:generate && pnpm run catalog:validate && pnpm run social:generate && astro dev
scripts.build: pnpm run marks:generate && pnpm run catalog:validate && pnpm run social:generate && astro build
scripts.check: pnpm run marks:generate && pnpm run catalog:validate && astro check
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config dist/server/wrangler.json
